exposure: non-conservative management of placenta accreta spectrum
outcome: feasibility of non-conservative management of PAS in a hybrid OR
safety of non-conservative management of PAS in a hybrid OR
cohort: 110 patients with histopathologically confirmed placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) treated at a university hospital, with 80 treated in a conventional operating room and 30 treated in a hybrid operating room.
finding: Non-conservative management of placenta accreta spectrum in a hybrid operating room was found to be feasible and safe, with a lower rate of intra-arterial catheter displacements and shorter operative times compared to a conventional operating room.
